name: Mobius Token
rootCause: 67 cents minted 9.73 quadrillion MBU via a double-decimal bug, letting an attacker siphon $2.15 million, dump tokens, and vanish through Tornado Cash. MobiusDAO went from launch to zero in three days - undone by math nobody may have bothered to test.

descriptions.text: 67 cents minted 9.73 quadrillion MBU via a double-decimal bug, letting an attacker siphon $2.15 million, dump tokens, and vanish through Tornado Cash. MobiusDAO went from launch to zero in three days - undone by math nobody may have bothered to test.
Mobius Token on BSC is suspected to have been exploited, with estimated losses of $2.15 million.

On May 11, 2025, Mobius Token (MBU) on BNB Chain was exploited via a surplus 1e18 multiplier in its unverified minting contract, allowing an attacker to mint over 9.73 quadrillion MBU for just 0.001 BNB. The attacker swapped the inflated tokens for $2.16 million USDT, draining liquidity and laundered proceeds through Tornado Cash. A surplus 1e18 decimal multiplier in Mobius Token's unverified minting contract led to extreme token inflation for minimal deposits. Pricing logic failed to normalize decimals, causing outsized minting. No audit or check caught this prior to deployment.

Mobius Token on BNB Chain was exploited on May 11, 2025, due to a token-minting logic error involving decimal miscalculation. The vulnerability enabled an attacker to mint 9.7 quadrillion MBU tokens with a tiny BNB deposit, resulting in the draining and exchange of approximately $2.16M worth of tokens within minutes. A surplus multiplication by 10^18 in Mobius Token's minting logic allowed an attacker to create an enormous quantity of tokens for a negligible BNB deposit. The calculation failed to correctly handle decimal precision on both price queries and final minting, enabling token inflation and massive extraction.
